newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq urges "criminal Clinton" to educate Americans.
newsitem.headline: Iraq urges "criminal Clinton" to educate Americans.

text.p: Iraq's ruling Baath party newspaper al-Thawra on Friday urged "criminal Clinton" to educate his citizens to solve their problems with other countries via dialogue and political means.

"It seems that the American administration from past periods until the period of criminal Clinton sees that conduct and morals have to be practised within American framework...based on arrogance and impudence," the paper said in a front-page editorial.

"The civilised behaviour, which American politicians do not know and do not seem to practise, requires...a civilised method represented in dialogue and the educating of the American people on the principles of human relations with other peoples and the pursuit of correct diplomacy in solving problems."
Thawra's remarks were part of fierce criticism of U.S. policies toward Iraq.

It said "morally America is debased" since its politicians, Republican and Democrat, distanced themselves from "logical behaviour...pursuing (instead) a path based on haughtiness and hatred of people's options."
There was no mention in the editorial of the U.S. armada of ships and assault planes closing in on Iraq to punish it for its defiance of allied no-fly zones.
The editorial also gave no hint of whether Iraq would stop firing at U.S. and allied warplanes and let them carry out their patrols peacefully.
